findings_addressed.oracle: State-transition gate: initialize() is called first so that get_available_tools() returns _BRIDGE_COUNT_ALL (7) items (verified pre-condition), then shutdown() is called, and the post-condition asserts get_available_tools() == [] and get_tool_definitions() == []. The pre-condition check anchors the transition; if no bridges were loaded the pre-check itself fails, preventing a vacuous pass.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: Remove self._bridges.clear() from ToolRegistry.shutdown() (src/intellicrack/core/tools.py line 281); after shutdown, get_available_tools() would still return the 7 bridge names registered before shutdown, causing the post-condition assertion get_available_tools() == [] to fail.

findings_addressed.oracle: The directory is NOT pre-created; ToolRegistry.__init__ wires tools_dir into ToolInstaller whose __init__ mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)s it. Asserts (a) tools_directory == tools_dir, (b) .name == 'tools_root', and (c) tools_dir.is_dir() AFTER construction (host-verified: dir absent before, present after) - proving tools_dir is genuinely used by the installer, not merely echoed by a getter.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: Either change 'return self._tools_dir' to 'return self._tools_dir.parent' at tools.py:134 (eq/name fail), OR make __init__ pass a different/hardcoded dir to ToolInstaller (the passed tools_dir is never created -> is_dir() fails).

findings_addressed.oracle: Structural gate via _assert_real_tool_definitions: len == _BRIDGE_COUNT_ALL (7), every element isinstance ToolDefinition, the set of def.tool_name equals set(get_available_tools()), each def has a non-empty description and >=1 ToolFunction (each isinstance ToolFunction). A return of list(self._bridges.values()) (7 bridge objects) passes the old len==7 but fails the isinstance(ToolDefinition) gate.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: Change get_tool_definitions to return list(self._bridges.values()) (tools.py:519) - count stays 7 but isinstance(d, ToolDefinition) fails; OR broaden the except to drop a bridge's definition - the tool_name set no longer equals available tools and len < 7.

notes: G0121 re-hardened (wave-2 adversarial review): the previous version called shutdown() on the un-initialized fixture (empty _bridges), making both post-conditions trivially true before the call. Fix: the test now calls initialize() first, asserts _BRIDGE_COUNT_ALL bridges and definitions exist (pre-condition anchor), then calls shutdown() and asserts both return []. The pre-condition anchor ensures the transition is observable; the documented mutation (remove _bridges.clear()) would leave get_available_tools() non-empty and fail the post-condition. POST-WORKFLOW FIX (2026-06-22): adversarial reviewer flagged G0122 and G0123 as still non-falsifiable. G0122 (test_tools_directory) only echoed the constructor arg and asserted .exists() after the test itself mkdir'd the dir (vacuous) - rewritten to NOT pre-create the dir and assert it exists after construction (the ToolInstaller mkdir proves tools_dir is wired, not echoed) plus the .name check. G0123 (test_get_tool_definitions_after_init) only asserted len==7 (a list of 7 bridge objects would pass) - rewritten via _assert_real_tool_definitions to gate isinstance ToolDefinition, the exact tool_name set == available tools, and non-empty description + ToolFunction list per definition. Both verified GREEN in sandbox.
